description: Signed-in Pro or Firm attorneys only. After the note is in the attorney's case-management system AND the attorney has confirmed it, marks that queued note posted in their Pro Workspace (status entered, by Claude), with the system and an optional reference (for example the matter or note id). Changes nothing else: the note's text and record stay as the attorney wrote them. A draft, a note already posted, or a note that is not theirs is not touched.

external_ref.description: Optional. The record id or link in that system.

name: mark_hearing_note_posted
title: Mark a hearing note posted
